image_description: A close-up shot of a chunky, handmade-style necklace worn around a person's neck. The necklace consists of large, spherical beads wrapped in textured yarn or thread in earthy tones (browns, greens, purples, greys). The beads are strung closely together on a thick cord. The background shows the wearer's skin and a hint of clothing.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the yarn wrapping on the beads is slightly repetitive and lacks the fine, chaotic fiber detail of real wool/cotton. It has a slight 'smudged' or painted look typical of AI generation, though not severe.

The connection points where the beads meet the main cord are somewhat ambiguous. In several places, the cord seems to merge into the bead wrapping without a clear hole or string passage, suggesting minor structural logic failure.
The curvature of the necklace on the right side flattens out slightly against the skin, lacking the consistent volumetric shadowing expected from a heavy object resting on soft tissue.
